fusions.name: Weighted Net
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted net that deals 10 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shots from the Blind
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darts at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. Against enemies that have not yet been hurt, their critical chance rises by 50%. It holds 3 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Dyed to the Brush
fusions.desc: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Folded Light
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
